name: toolpermit
description: Configure local MCP tool-call policy, approval, replay, and redacted audit workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Guard local MCP tool calls with reviewable policy.
interface.longDescription: Install and configure ToolPermit around local MCP stdio servers, start in observe mode, derive and replay policies from redacted evidence, and move to explicit one-time approvals only after review.
defaultPrompt: Install ToolPermit and safely wrap my local MCP stdio server.
Review my ToolPermit policy and replay it against recorded calls.
Diagnose why my ToolPermit-wrapped MCP server will not start.
